subject: Important Update on Your Job Application
body: Dear Applicant, We are pleased to inform you that your job application for the Marketing Specialist position has been shortlisted for the next round of interviews. Please confirm your availability for an interview on Monday, March 15th at 10:00 AM. We look forward to discussing your qualifications further. If you have any scheduling conflicts, please let us know as soon as possible. Thank you for your interest in joining our team. Best regards, Hiring Manager
